title: Dinosaur reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dinosaur body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- Dinosaur head -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="32" r="16" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="36" r="1.5" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="28" r="4" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="28" r="2" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="49.7" cy="27.2" r="0.7" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 33 43 Q 38 47 43 44" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Spikes on head -->
  <polygon points="45,16 48,24 42,24" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <polygon points="55,18 57,26 52,26" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <path d="M 38 55 Q 32 62 38 68" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 62 55 Q 68 62 62 68" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <path d="M 36 58 L 36 76 L 50 72 L 50 54 Z" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <path d="M 64 58 L 64 76 L 50 72 L 50 54 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="54" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Book lines -->
  <line x1="39" y1="62" x2="47" y2="59" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="66" x2="47" y2="63" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="70" x2="47" y2="67" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="59" x2="61" y2="62" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="63" x2="61" y2="66" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="67" x2="61" y2="70" stroke="#F57F17" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M 68 72 Q 82 75 86 62 Q 88 55 82 52" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="84" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="84" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="88" rx="8" ry="3" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="88" rx="8" ry="3" fill="#2E7D32"/>
</svg>
